text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Oguri, Oguuuri! Hey, wake up already!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
What d'you mean 'what', you're the one who 
told me to bring you to the cafeteria! 
Saying you're sleepy but still wanna eat 
lunch.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I was lost in thought all through last 
night... Before I knew it, it was morning.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yet still, I can find no answer... 
Trainer, Tama, do either of you know the 
answer?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"What's this, sounds like a real serious 
worry. Go on, spit it out!"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yesterday, I ran the course while eating a 
rice ball, but...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I thought if I ate while training, I'd get 
even stronger.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
However, it didn't yield much in the way 
of results... Was the quantity not enough, 
or perhaps bread would have been—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: No, that's not the problem at all!!

Afterward, beside a completely exasperated 
Tamamo Cross, there was Oguri Cap, 
heartily devouring her lunch even while 
dozing off.
